raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-18 the source sends a reversal as a separate REVERSAL row pointing to the original via orig_txn_id, and the original stays POSTED. silver_transactions keeps only POSTED rows, so reversed originals are still counted and totals are inflated. Before the change, reversed originals were marked REVERSED and excluded. The fix excludes POSTED originals that a REVERSAL row references. The REVERSAL rows themselves are already excluded by the status filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id)"}}
